notes: Retrospective cohort study (medical records, January 2023 to December 2025), Ophthalmology Department, Victor Babes University of Medicine and Pharmacy, Timisoara, Romania; treatment chosen by parents or caregivers (not randomised).

237 children met the inclusion criteria (DIMS 119, SV 118); 36 were excluded for incomplete data (16), follow-up shorter than 365 ± 30 days (13) or partial compliance (7); 201 analysed (DIMS 104, SV 97). The analysed sets are 87% and 82% of the groups that met the inclusion criteria, at least 70% (protocol inclusion 5), so they are admitted.

Inclusion required baseline axial length between 22 and 26 mm and spherical equivalent between -0.50 and -6.00 D (pre-treatment criteria); spectacles worn 10-12 h a day; lenses replaced when myopia progressed by more than 0.5 D.
Right eye designated as the primary outcome; left eyes tabulated separately and not extracted.
Spherical equivalent refraction is also tabulated (Tables 1-3), not extracted.
